# Audio, music & voice

Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, music generation, podcast cleanup, and audio repair tools. Free options cover a surprising range, but time limits, licensing, and whether you may use a voice or song commercially vary enormously.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **17 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** Only clone or imitate a voice with clear permission. Record everyone's consent before transcribing a meeting. Free music plans often prohibit commercial use, and open-source music models may carry non-commercial weights. Keep the original recording, and treat automated transcripts as drafts.

**Start here:** [Whisper](#tool-whisper) · [Otter.ai](#tool-otter-ai) · [ElevenLabs](#tool-elevenlabs)

## All 17 tools

<a id="tool-elevenlabs"></a>

### ElevenLabs

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free monthly character allowance for realistic text-to-speech, plus access to some voice library voices and audio tools.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. A monthly character allowance and attribution or commercial rules apply.
- **Limits:** The free character cap is small, roughly a short audio piece. Voice cloning, commercial terms, higher-quality audio, and more languages/voices require paid plans. Attribution or commercial restrictions can apply.
- **Best for:** Narration samples and accessible voiceovers where you want natural-sounding speech.
- **Official link:** <https://elevenlabs.io>
- **Tags:** `text-to-speech` `voiceover` `narration` `accessibility`

<a id="tool-murf"></a>

### Murf AI

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A modest free allowance of AI voice generation and access to a selection of voices and editing tools.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. Limited monthly generation time and restricted voices apply.
- **Limits:** Free monthly generation time is limited, some voices and export options are restricted, and commercial use depends on the plan. Higher volume and voice cloning are paid.
- **Best for:** Corporate-style narration, e-learning samples, and voiceover drafts.

<a id="tool-speechify"></a>

### Speechify

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free text-to-speech listening in the browser and apps using standard voices, with adjustable speed and basic reading features.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. Standard voices and limited listening features apply.
- **Limits:** Premium voices, offline listening, advanced AI tools, and higher usage are paid. Free features and voice availability change by platform.
- **Best for:** Listening to articles or documents at higher speed when you prefer audio to reading.
- **Official link:** <https://speechify.com>
- **Tags:** `text-to-speech` `accessibility` `reading` `productivity`

<a id="tool-naturalreader"></a>

### NaturalReader

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free browser and app text-to-speech with standard voices, document upload, and adjustable reading speed.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free web or app access; no card. Some uses may require an account; premium voices cost money.
- **Limits:** Premium voices, offline use, more file formats, and commercial usage require paid plans. Daily or feature limits apply to free accounts.

<a id="tool-whisper"></a>

### Whisper

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** OpenAI's open-source speech-recognition model that can transcribe and translate audio locally with no per-minute service fee.
- **Sign-up notes:** Install from the official repository; no account or card. Requires Python and local compute.
- **Limits:** You need Python, technical setup, and enough compute. Accuracy drops with noise, accents, overlap, and specialist vocabulary. Local use does not automatically make sensitive recordings safe under workplace rules.
- **Best for:** Private transcription, subtitles, and repeatable speech-to-text on your own machine.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/openai/whisper>
- **Tags:** `transcription` `local` `privacy` `speech-to-text`

<a id="tool-macwhisper"></a>

### MacWhisper

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free local transcription on macOS with downloaded Whisper-style models, drag-and-drop files, and basic exports.
- **Sign-up notes:** Download the free Mac app; no account or card. The free tier excludes advanced features.
- **Limits:** The free version covers basic local transcription; batch processing, speaker recognition, advanced export, and cloud AI features are paid. Larger models need more memory.
- **Best for:** Mac users who want simple local transcription without a subscription or an upload.
- **Official link:** <https://www.macwhisper.com>
- **Tags:** `transcription` `local` `mac` `privacy`

<a id="tool-otter-ai"></a>

### Otter.ai

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free meeting transcription with a monthly minute allowance, automated summaries, and searchable notes in the web and mobile apps.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Otter account; no card. Monthly minutes and per-meeting limits apply.

<a id="tool-adobe-podcast"></a>

### Adobe Podcast Enhance

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free web-based AI speech enhancement that can reduce room noise and make voice recordings sound clearer.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Adobe account; no card. Upload and processing limits apply.
- **Limits:** Requires an Adobe account and is subject to processing time, file, and usage limits. It works best on clean speech; music and badly clipped audio can sound artificial.
- **Best for:** Rescuing voice memos or podcast recordings made in an imperfect room.
- **Official link:** <https://podcast.adobe.com>
- **Tags:** `audio-cleanup` `podcast` `speech` `editing`

<a id="tool-suno"></a>

### Suno

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A daily allowance of credits to generate full songs with vocals or instrumentals from a prompt or lyric idea.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account; no card. Daily credits, queue restrictions, and non-commercial terms apply.
- **Limits:** Free credits are limited, outputs may carry restrictions, and free-plan songs generally cannot be used commercially. Higher quality, more generations, and ownership/use rights require paid plans.
- **Best for:** Song sketches, creative gifts, and experimenting with lyrics and styles, not commercial releases.
- **Official link:** <https://suno.com>
- **Tags:** `music` `songs` `creative` `noncommercial`

<a id="tool-audiocraft"></a>

### AudioCraft

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Meta's open-source audio-generation codebase, including MusicGen and AudioGen, for running music and sound models locally.
- **Sign-up notes:** Install from the official repository; no account or card. Requires Python and capable hardware.
- **Limits:** Requires Python, model downloads, and capable hardware. Model weights and licenses may restrict commercial use. Output quality and control are not the same as polished hosted services.
- **Best for:** Technical experiments with local music and sound-effect generation.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/facebookresearch/audiocraft>
